config.script:
c = self.view.custom.container
	cellId = self.session.custom.cell.locationId
	if not c or c.get("Id") is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult({"Status": False, "Message": "No open container at this cell."}, "Assembly")
		return
	result = BlueRidge.Lots.Container.complete(c.get("Id"), operatorConfirmed=True, terminalLocationId=cellId)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, "Container complete")
	if result and result.get("Status"):
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

transforms.code:
rows = value or []
	n = len(rows)
	term = None
	cell = None
	try:
		term = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
		cell = self.session.custom.cell.locationId
	except:
		pass
	return [
		{
			"index": i, "totalRows": n,
			"printerLocationId": r.get("PrinterLocationId"),
			"printerCode": r.get("PrinterCode") or "",
			"printerName": r.get("PrinterName") or "",
			"endpoint": r.get("Endpoint") or "",
			"connectionKind": r.get("ConnectionKind") or "",
			"assignedItemId": r.get("AssignedItemId"),
			"partNumber": r.get("PartNumber") or "",
			"description": r.get("Description") or "",
			"sortOrder": r.get("SortOrder") or 0,
			"openContainerId": r.get("OpenContainerId"),
			"fillAccum": r.get("FillAccum") or 0,
			"fillTarget": r.get("FillTarget") or 0,
			"isFull": r.get("IsFull") or 0,
			"cellLocationId": cell,
			"terminalLocationId": term
		}
		for i, r in enumerate(rows)
	]

customMethods.name: handleAssign
customMethods.script:
cards = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.printerCards) or []
	rows = []
	for c in cards:
		c = c or {}
		pid = c.get("PrinterLocationId")
		iid = c.get("AssignedItemId")
		if pid == printerLocationId:
			iid = itemId
		elif iid == itemId:
			iid = None
		rows.append({"PrinterLocationId": pid, "ItemId": iid, "SortOrder": c.get("SortOrder") or 0})
	result = BlueRidge.Location.PrinterFgAssignment.saveAll(self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId, rows)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, "Printer assignment saved")
	self.refreshCards()
